column1: # Format: English<TAB>Chinese, where the English side is the literal exactly
# as it appears in ../vba.rc.  The & marks the accelerator key and sits on the
# character it names, the way the English entry does; a translation that keeps
# the English word or number does the same.  Only where the key is in a word
# the translation replaced, so the character is not there at all, does the
# entry end in "(&X)" - that is how Chinese Windows writes it.
